meta.source: USDA Forest Service, Forest Health Assessment and Applied Sciences Team (2025). 2024 National Insect and Disease Risk Map: composite risk of tree mortality from insects and diseases, 2024-2038, 240 m.
meta.definition: At risk: 25 percent or more of the standing live basal area of trees over 1 inch in diameter expected to die from insects and diseases over 2024-2038, without remediation.
